title: Fashion Discount Codes: ASOS, Old Navy, UNIQLO | VoucherVault
description: Live fashion promo codes from ASOS, H&M, Old Navy, Kohl's and UNIQLO: first-order codes, clearance extras and app rewards, checked on brand sites.
intro: Clothing codes from global fashion retailers, from first-order discounts to extra money off clearance.

image.alt: Clothing boutique with rails of clothes

sections.html:
• Clearance + code: extra-off-clearance codes stack on already reduced prices, often the biggest saving of the season.
  • First-order codes only work on a new account; use them on your biggest first basket.
  • Returns: in the UK and EU you normally have 14 days to cancel most online orders; in the US returns depend on the store's policy, so check it before buying sale items.

cardText: ASOS, H&M, Old Navy, Kohl's, UNIQLO and more.
